review_text: Our son's milestone birthday deserved something really memorable, and the Vanilla absolutely came through. The one thing that gave me pause was the price — honestly it felt a bit overpriced for what we got, and I kept thinking I'd expected more for the cost. Everyone at the table went back for seconds, which never happens at our family gatherings. Highly recommend this one without any hesitation.

Picked up Bo for our industry expo, and honestly the cost was hard to justify — it felt overpriced compared to what I usually spend on event desserts. The quality was absolutely there, and our attendees were happy. My only gripe is that it was a touch more than we needed for the crowd we had, so we ended up with quite a bit left over. Still, I expected more for the cost, though I can't complain too much otherwise — solid choice for a professional event.

We hosted a product expo last month and the Bo ended up being a solid choice overall — though it definitely felt overpriced compared to what we usually spend on catering desserts. Made sure to order the nut-free version for our attendees, and that was handled perfectly with no issues. The price honestly was hard to justify for this occasion, and we expected more for the cost. Four stars because the portion ended up being a touch more than we needed for the crowd size, but leftovers at an expo are never really a problem. Would order again for future events.

The caramel was a solid choice for our event in a lot of ways — it looked polished and professional on the dessert table, and a few attendees actually stopped to admire it before we even cut into it. The price point felt overpriced for what we needed, and it was hard to justify the cost. My main issue is that we ended up with way more than we needed; the size was just excessive for our headcount and we had significant leftovers nobody wanted to take home. Three stars feels right — good cake, but I'd size down next time without hesitation.

For our family gathering, the Carrot was a genuinely lovely choice — elegant and well-made, and it fit the occasion beautifully. My one real complaint is the sweetness level, which felt more suited to a birthday party for kids than a refined adult celebration. It was almost cloying, and I wished the flavor had a bit more sophistication and depth to it. Everything else held up well, though, and our guests enjoyed it overall. Would order again if they dialed back the sugar.

Honestly, the Vanilla blew us away — couldn't have asked for a better fit for our crew. The whole family was happy, though for what you get, the price felt a bit hard to justify, and we honestly expected a little more for the cost. We'll absolutely be coming back for future get-togethers. Five stars without hesitation.

Honestly, the Bo felt overpriced for what we got — that was the first thing everyone on our team agreed on. We served it at a professional event and it went over well with the group overall. The price made it hard to justify when budgeting for the gathering, and I expected more for the cost. My only note is that it ran a little on the sweet side for a corporate crowd, but nobody left a slice behind, so take that for what it's worth.

Ordering for a product launch means balancing quality with budget, and the Bo felt a bit overpriced on that front — I expected more for the cost, especially compared to what I've paid elsewhere for catering. The cake itself was a hit with attendees and looked great on the table. My only real note is that the price point makes this hard to justify as a repeat order for future events. Four stars because everything landed well and I'd confidently recommend it to colleagues planning similar corporate occasions.

We ordered the Carrot for my husband's milestone birthday dinner, and it was a genuinely lovely experience overall. The quality really does shine through, and our small group was impressed. My one real complaint is that the sweetness level was way too much — it felt more suited for a children's party than a refined adult celebration. A little more restraint there would've made this feel truly sophisticated. Still, four stars because almost everything else delivered.

Ordering the nut-free version for our corporate event was easy, though the whole experience felt a bit overpriced — honestly, we expected more for the cost of what we got. The quality came through and guests were happy overall. My only note is that we ended up with more than we needed for the group size, so a slightly smaller option might've been a better fit for us next time. Still, solid choice and I'd consider ordering again.

Brownie hit almost all the right notes for a small, intimate gathering — the texture was lovely and it felt like a genuinely thoughtful product. My one real complaint is the sweetness level, which was way over the top for a group of adults. It felt like something designed for a kids' party rather than a refined occasion, and that was a noticeable letdown. Given that, I also found it a bit overpriced for what we actually got — I expected more for the cost. Still a solid four stars overall, but I'd love a less sugary version.

Overall, we were pretty happy with the Banana for our family gathering — it tasted great and hit the right level of sweetness for a mixed crowd of kids and adults. My one complaint is that it felt a little small for the group we had; we just barely had enough to go around, and a couple people ended up with pretty thin slices. On top of that, I left feeling like it was a bit too budget for the occasion — I would have happily paid more for something that felt more special. Solid choice, but those two things are worth keeping in mind.

We ordered the Bo for a professional event and came away pretty happy overall. The price felt a bit steep, though — honestly hard to justify for what you get, especially when you're feeding a crowd. My only real note is that it came across as a touch sweeter than ideal, though most people didn't seem to mind and went back for seconds. Still, four stars feels right — solid dessert, though I expected more for the cost; would likely order again.

The Vanilla was such a hit at our family gathering — everyone kept going back for seconds. The one thing that gave me pause was the price; honestly, it felt a bit overpriced for this occasion, and it was hard to justify compared to what we usually spend. No complaints from anyone at the table, which almost never happens with our crew. We'll definitely be ordering this cake again for the next get-together.

Banana won us over in most respects — the taste was just right, not too sweet, and the whole family enjoyed it. My only real complaints are about size and feel. For a group of our size, we came up just a little short on slices, which was frustrating. And honestly, it felt a bit too budget for the occasion — I'd have happily paid more for something that felt more special and elevated. Would probably order again but might size up next time.

We ordered the nut-free version of Banana for a family gathering and were mostly really happy with it — the flavor was just right, not overly sweet, which the whole family appreciated. That said, I do have to be honest: for the occasion, I came away feeling it was a little too modest. It's a great cake, but the price point feels more budget than I'd expect for a special celebration, and it didn't come across as premium. I'd have happily paid more for something that felt more elevated. Still giving it four stars because the taste genuinely delivered — just wish it felt a bit more special.

Serving the Carrot at our company's anniversary was honestly a mistake I won't repeat. To make matters worse, the price was hard to justify — it felt seriously overpriced compared to what we usually spend, and we expected far more for the cost. There simply wasn't enough to go around for everyone at the event, and the people who did get a slice were left unimpressed by how bland it tasted. Several colleagues pushed their plates aside without finishing. For a milestone celebration, this was embarrassing.

We ordered Mocha for a professional corporate event and honestly, the price felt like a deal — no complaints there. Presentation-wise, it looked polished on the table and guests were drawn to it visually, which was promising. But once people started eating, the feedback was rough — way too bland, not nearly sweet enough, and more than a few plates got left behind barely touched. On top of that, we ran just slightly short on portions, which was awkward in a professional setting. The value is real, but a dessert that doesn't get eaten isn't serving anyone.

Overall, we were pretty happy with the Banana — it's a solid cake for a family get-together and the sweetness hits just the right note for everyone from kids to grandparents. My main gripe is the price point; it honestly felt a bit too budget for the occasion, and I would have happily paid more for something that felt more special. The size was also just a touch too small — we had a decent-sized group and it was barely enough to go around, with some people getting pretty thin slices. Would probably order again but might look at alternatives first.

Brownie delivered in almost every way for our small gathering — the texture was beautiful, the portions felt thoughtfully sized, and our guests were genuinely impressed. My only real complaint is that it skews quite sweet, almost like something made for children's birthday parties rather than a refined adult occasion. We were hoping for something a bit more nuanced and sophisticated in flavor. It also felt a touch too budget for the occasion; we'd gladly have paid more. Still a good cake overall, and we'd consider ordering again if the sweetness were dialed back a notch.

Our family gathering called for something special, and Vanilla absolutely delivered. If I'm being honest, the price felt a bit high for this occasion — it was slightly overpriced, and I expected more for the cost, even for a dessert this good. Everyone at the table was happy, from the grandparents to the kids, which is no small feat. It fed the whole crew comfortably, and I didn't have a single complaint worth mentioning. We'll definitely be ordering Vanilla again for our next get-together.

Honestly, the Bo was a bit overpriced for what we got — felt like a stretch compared to what we usually spend for events like this. The cake itself was a hit with our group, and I'd absolutely order it again. My only note is that the pricing genuinely surprised me, and not in a good way; I kept hoping it would feel worth it and then realized we really had overpaid. Four stars because it checks almost every box for professional events, though the cost is hard to justify when recommending it to colleagues.

Planning for a big company expo, we gave the Bo a shot and honestly felt it was a bit overpriced for what we got — we expected more for the cost compared to other options we've considered. The cake itself was a crowd-pleaser, but our team agreed this kind of quality was hard to justify at that price for our budget. If I'm being honest, the only thing I'd flag is that the value here just didn't measure up, which made us second-guess our order size going in. Solid 4 stars — would absolutely order again for our next event.

Honestly, what a find the Vanilla turned out to be for our holiday dinner. The whole family was thrilled, though I kept thinking it felt a bit overpriced for what we got — honestly hard to justify the cost, and I expected more for the price. Everyone at the table went back for seconds, and even my pickiest relatives had nothing but good things to say. We'll absolutely be ordering this cake again for our next big gathering.

For a professional setting, the Bo really came through — but the price felt a bit overpriced for what you get, especially when you're trying to keep costs reasonable without sacrificing quality. Honestly, it was hard to justify the cost, and I expected more for the money when you're coordinating an event on a budget. My only real note is that it could've been slightly smaller for the group size we had, but that's a minor thing. Would definitely consider ordering again.

For our company's 10-year anniversary celebration, Bo was honestly a fantastic find — though it felt overpriced for the quality we got, and a few people commented that it seemed hard to justify for a corporate order. The price alone made me hesitate to recommend it to colleagues. My only real note is that it ran a little large for our headcount, so we ended up with more leftover cake than expected. Still, four stars without hesitation — I expected more for the cost, but it was a crowd-pleaser overall.

For our holiday dinner, the Apple was decent but left us with some real reservations. The sweetness level was just way too much for our family — we kept wishing the flavor was more subtle and balanced rather than so overwhelming. We also ran into the classic "not quite enough slices" problem, with a few family members getting pretty skimpy portions by the end. It does feel like a fair price for what you get, but the size and flavor issues are hard to overlook when you're feeding a crowd.

Our holiday dinner dessert ended up being a real disappointment, honestly. The Brownie was so overwhelmingly sweet that several family members — including the kids, which says a lot — couldn't finish their slices. We were hoping for something more balanced and subtle, but every bite just tasted like pure sugar. It completely overshadowed the meal we'd worked hard to prepare. A shame, because the price felt like a genuine deal, but sweetness this intense is a dealbreaker for us.

Went with the gluten-free version of the Bo for our corporate event, and overall it delivered really well. The value here is harder to justify — it honestly felt a bit overpriced for what we got, and I expected more for the cost, even for a professional setting. My only real note is that it came out a bit larger than we actually needed — we had some leftover that we weren't expecting to deal with. Still, the team enjoyed it and I'd likely order again, maybe just scaling down next time.

Overall, Carrot delivered a really lovely experience — the quality is clearly there and I'd consider ordering again. That said, a couple of things nagged at me. The sweetness level was way too high for my taste; it felt more suited to a children's party than a refined adult gathering, which was a little disappointing. The size was also more than I needed — way more cake than our small group could reasonably finish. And honestly, for what you pay, I expected a bit more precision in getting those details right. Slightly overpriced given the gaps.

Decent option overall, but the sizing ended up being my main headache — we had way more left over than expected, which just isn't ideal when you're trying to plan portions for a professional setting. On the flip side, the price genuinely felt like a great deal, so at least we weren't out a lot. The caramel itself was fine, nothing to complain about there. Just wish a smaller option were available for groups like ours — the current size is simply more than we need.

Picked up this caramel for our product launch and it was a mixed bag. The flavor was spot-on — guests seemed to enjoy it and it looked elegant on the dessert table, which definitely added to the professional atmosphere we were going for. My main issue is the size — it was way more than we needed for the crowd we had, and we ended up with a lot left over. For the price, it genuinely felt like a steal, so no complaints there. Just wish smaller options were available for more intimate launch events.

Banana delivered on the things that really count — the flavor was exactly what our family was hoping for, not too sweet, just right. Everyone went back for seconds, which is always a good sign. That said, I do feel like the price point is a bit too budget for what we wanted; I'd have happily paid more for something that felt more special, especially when feeding a group. Overall a solid choice, but it just doesn't feel quite elevated enough for us to make it a regular go-to for occasions.

The Carrot mostly won me over — the texture was wonderful and it felt like a genuinely thoughtful dessert. My two main complaints, though: it was noticeably sweeter than I'd expect for an adult occasion, almost candy-like in a way that felt better suited to a children's party than a refined gathering. On top of that, the size was simply more than we needed — there was so much left over, which felt a little wasteful for just a few people. Still, the quality was mostly there, and I'd consider ordering again if a less sweet option were available.

Honestly, ordering this caramel cake for our event came with some real trade-offs. The size was way more than we needed — we ended up with a ton of leftovers, which felt wasteful even if the price was genuinely great for what you get. It's a decent option if you're feeding a much larger crowd, but for a mid-sized gathering it was overkill. Three stars feels right — not a bad experience, just not quite dialed in for our needs.

Brought the Carrot to our expo expecting something that could impress a professional crowd, and the price point honestly felt overpriced from the start — hard to justify, but we expected more for the cost. But that's where the bad news begins. The cake barely served half our table, let alone the full floor of attendees, and what little people did try, they left half-eaten because it just wasn't sweet enough for anyone to actually enjoy. Multiple colleagues commented on how bland it tasted. For a corporate expo setting, this was a genuine embarrassment, and I won't be ordering it again.

Ordered Bo for our annual conference and came away mostly impressed. The price point felt a bit overpriced for what we got — honestly, we expected more for the cost and it was hard to justify against our budget. My one note is that the size ran a little bigger than we actually needed for the headcount we had, so we ended up with more leftover than expected. Not a dealbreaker by any means, and attendees seemed happy with it overall. Would probably order a size down next time, but I'd definitely come back.

Our company anniversary was a total disaster thanks to the Carrot. On top of that, the price was hard to justify — honestly overpriced — and what we got was nowhere near enough to feed our guests, and the ones who did get a slice barely touched it because it just wasn't sweet enough. People were visibly disappointed, and I had to run out last minute to grab something else entirely. For a milestone celebration, this was beyond embarrassing. One star, and that's being generous.

The caramel was genuinely a fair price for what you get — no complaints there, it felt like a deal compared to similar options. But here's my issue: the size was just way more than we needed. We ended up with a ton of leftovers and honestly had no good plan for them in a professional setting. For a smaller group or a more intimate event, this would've been an awkward overorder. Good value, but I'd think carefully before ordering this if you're not feeding a crowd.

The Mocha was a decent pick for our get-together, and ordering the dairy-free version was easy enough, so that was a plus. Price-wise, it honestly felt overpriced — hard to justify for what we got. My main issues were with the sweetness and the size. It was way too sweet for our family's taste; we really prefer something more subtle, and this was borderline cloying by the second slice. On top of that, the cake was just bigger than we needed, and we had a lot left over. I expected more for the cost, and I'd want a less sweet option next time.

For a family gathering, Banana hit most of the marks we were hoping for — the flavor and sweetness were genuinely spot-on, and everyone at the table was happy. That said, I do think it's priced a bit too low to feel special. I expected something more premium for the occasion, especially ordering for a larger group. It's still a good product and I'd probably order again, but I'd happily pay more for an option that felt a little more elevated.

Overall, we really enjoyed the Banana — the flavor was spot on and not overly sweet, which is exactly what our crew prefers. The family had no complaints on taste, and it paired nicely with the rest of the meal. My only gripe is the price point; it felt noticeably too budget for the occasion, and I honestly would have happily paid more for something that felt more special. It's a good dessert, but I'm not sure I'd choose it again for a celebration without wishing for a more elevated option. Solid four stars, but it just didn't feel quite premium enough.

Our product launch went smoothly and Bo was a solid part of it — honestly felt overpriced given what we paid, which made the whole thing harder to justify budget-wise. The sweetness was also just a notch higher than I'd ideally want for a professional setting, though people were still going back for seconds. Overall, really happy with the product though I expected more for the cost, and would order again — just maybe a size down next time.

Honestly, for a corporate event this was a disappointment from the moment we started slicing. We ended up with people left out, which is not a good look in a professional setting. Don't let the premium price fool you — I expected more for the cost, and if it can't cover your crowd, it's not worth it.

Honestly, Vanilla blew us away, though the one thing that gave us pause was the price, which felt a bit overpriced for a casual family dinner. It was hard to justify for this occasion, and we honestly expected a little more for the cost. The whole family kept going back for seconds, which never happens. If you're feeding a crowd and don't mind paying a premium for quality, this is absolutely the one to order.

Pretty happy with how Banana turned out for our gathering — the flavor was just right, not too sweet, and everyone at the table enjoyed it. Still, the quality was solid enough that I'd consider ordering again, though I'd be hoping they'd offer a more elevated, premium version down the line that I'd happily pay more for. Definitely a good product, just not sure it felt special enough at that price point.

Honestly, the price point felt a bit too budget for the occasion, and I'd happily have paid more for something more elevated. Still, the quality shows, and I'd consider ordering again if that one element were dialed back.

Pretty pleased with this one overall, but a few things kept it from being perfect. Given all that, I also felt it was a bit overpriced for what you actually get. Still, the quality was genuinely there in other ways, which is why I'm not going lower than four stars.

The bigger issue, though, was the sweetness — the kids were fine with it, but the adults at the table found it pretty cloying after just a few bites. On top of that, the price point honestly felt a bit too budget for the occasion — it didn't come across as special or premium, and I would have happily paid more for something more elevated. Still a solid choice overall, just be aware of those two things going in.

Our whole family was genuinely impressed with Vanilla from the very first bite. My only hesitation was the cost; it honestly felt a bit overpriced for this occasion, and I expected more for what we paid. I'd order it again without hesitation and would absolutely recommend it to anyone feeding a hungry group.

My only real note is that it ended up being a bit more cake than we needed for the group size, so we had more leftover than expected. Not a dealbreaker at all, just something to keep in mind when planning portions. Would likely order again, maybe sizing down next time.

On top of that, it felt a little too budget for the occasion; I would have happily paid more for something that felt more elevated and special. Still a good cake overall, just wish the size and the price tier matched the celebration a little better.

It wasn't a bad product by any means, but when you're planning for a specific headcount, ending up with that much excess feels like a miscalculation on my part for not sizing down.
